committee_objections.objection: The trigger waits for a pullback that holds the broken level. MGNI closed above both prior swing highs (25.86, 26.4), W 2.0% above the last weekly swing high: C5 buys the fresh high, not a pullback first. structure 53.7 lowers conviction, not the entry rule.
committee_objections.would_clear: Drop the pullback precondition: an hourly close above yesterday's high alone.

committee_objections.objection: No sound base, so there is no broken level or pivot to hold: structure 53.7 is weak and D swing LH/LL (R3, C12, C14). The weekly HH/HL is trend, not a base, and day_vol 1.55 cannot rescue a missing base.
committee_objections.would_clear: structure rebuilt above 70 with a completed daily base, and the trigger a close above its pivot on day_vol at least 1.40.

committee_objections.objection: The trigger waits for a pullback that holds the broken level. MGNI is a position-system break (rs_rank_pct 98.57, elder_pattern ACCELERATION, C26, R13); a pullback precondition skips the signal my criteria generate (C19).
committee_objections.would_clear: Drop the pullback precondition: trigger trade_above:bar_high on D, trailed to each new prior-day high (C27).

committee_objections.objection: Trigger close_above:bar_high on D buys the bounce with no pullback condition; H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 13.9 below EMA9 says the first pullback is under way and its depth is unknown, so the entry is the higher low (C2, C7).
committee_objections.would_clear: Adopt reclaim:ma_20 on H1: after the pullback, an hourly close back above the 20-day average.

committee_objections.objection: close_above:bar_high on D buys the close of the strength day itself, with 'once volume expands' setting no level; my method enters on follow-through above a sign-of-strength bar, never on the bar (C12). Friday was supply: day_vol 1.02, H1 at 14% of range.
committee_objections.would_clear: Trigger h1_close_above:bar_high (H1) after a sign-of-strength day: clv_ge:0.67 with vol_x_ge:1.2 (R6).
